login.tagline: Sign in to manage your presentations
login.genericError: Could not sign you in. Please try again.
login.noProviderDescription: Set GitHub or Google OAuth credentials in .env (see .env.example), then restart the instance.
login.sharedAccessHint: Has access been shared with you? Use “Sign in with Google” with the address it was granted to.
login.openDeckDescription: You are signed in. Open the presentation {path}.

unlock.title: Protected presentation
unlock.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

deckError.defaultMessage: The presentation could not be loaded.
deckError.notFoundMessage: The link may be out of date, or the presentation was renamed. If it was shared with another account, sign in with that one.
deckError.privateMessage: Sign in with the account it was shared with.
deckError.unpublishedTitle: This presentation is not published yet
deckError.unpublishedMessage: You can edit it or present its draft. Once published, it opens at this address for the accounts that have access.
